scope: Separate cleanup controller for the sixteen copied wallet proofs in the two completed fusion-registration jobs. No real experiment artifacts were deleted.

validation.label: controller

implementation_boundaries: plan is read-only and calls the pinned complete-trial reporter for both off/on consumers.
apply requires the existing bounded-controller admission checks, no other live experiment service, and the shared exclusive experiment lease.
apply rebuilds its plan; it does not accept a saved plan from disk.
Both registration jobs, both completed proof jobs, and the shared fixture are bound to original manifest pins and artifact identities.
Only wallet.0 through wallet.7 in each registration job may be unlinked; keys, height, proof roots, original manifests, and shared wallet proofs remain.
Reject noncanonical/symlink paths, extra or changed files, hard-linked or non-private wallet files, replaced directories, and reused output directories.
A durable attempted receipt precedes deletion; directory-descriptor-relative deletion is followed by fsync and per-file journaling.
Any interrupted or partial deletion requires manual inspection; no automatic resume.
Post-pruning preservation checks do not constitute a fresh cryptographic replay.
limitations: The 26 cleanup tests use tiny synthetic artifacts and stub the full cryptographic report inspection.
No real cleanup-controller/systemd lifecycle or complete apply invocation on measured fixtures has been performed.
The original single/grouped repeated benchmark is running; no extra experiment service, prover, or heavy build/test was launched.
After registration cleanup, the original pre-pruning reporter will reject absent wallet copies; preserve the receipt and previously checked comparison.
All intended consumers must finish before real cleanup. Final shared-fixture pruning and fresh CPU replay of both fusion roots remain required.
